explanation: For λ>0, y'(0)=0 gives y=B cos(5x√λ), and y'(π)=0 requires 5√λ=n. Thus the requested formulas are λ_n=n²/25 and y_n=B_n cos(5x√λ_n)=B_n cos(nx). Also, λ=0 has nonzero constant eigenfunctions. The complete spectrum uses n=0,1,2,… and B_n≠0; if N excludes zero, that mode must be listed separately. This convention does not change either formula blank.
